name: Adyen N.V.
quirks: Euronext Amsterdam ordinary listing (EUR). 1 ADYEY ADR = 1/100 ordinary share. Half-yearly reporting (H1/H2 shareholder letters; H2 letter carries FY figures) plus revenue-only Q1/Q3 business updates. Balance-sheet cash is mostly MERCHANT SETTLEMENT FLOAT - own cash = cash - payables to merchants + receivables (FY2025 net cash ~EUR4.7bn, not the EUR10.8bn headline). No financial debt, only IFRS-16 leases. Revenue column intentionally blank; NetRevenue is the top line. Filings/extracts shared with the ADYEY folder.
